notes.title: Ergastulum - Development Update
notes.notes:
Ergastulum development is still going strong! Please add the game to your Wishlist for the latest development updates :)

A lot of changes have happened recently and I wanted to share some of the latest additions to the game.

Most recently, I have started to work on the traps found in the dungeons and will be a re-imagination of what I did in Dungeon Nightmares II.

Pendulums
https://i.imgur.com/4aErmdW.png

A Close Shave
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sIZaz5MO4FQ

Crushers
https://i.imgur.com/cpgNrdE.png

notes.title: Ergastulum Beta Update
notes.notes:
A much loved character is returning to the new game  Ergastulum

Boney

As you can see, he's had a few upgrades since Dungeon Nightmares :) this is now in the new Beta.

A friendly reminder to please show your help and support for my new game on Kickstarter. Every bit helps and makes it possible for me to complete this game.

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Released
notes.notes:
Options are now available on the Main Menu.

Patch Notes

Added mouse invert option for both vertical and horizontal
Added mouse sensitivity
Added game pad sensitivity
Added V-Sync toggle
Fixed a minor trap bug
